resources.string: Use your gateway account. For self-signed TLS, copy its SHA-256 certificate fingerprint from a trusted server console. No trust-all mode.
Share only supported USB/OMAPI SIM authentication with this gateway? No raw APDU tunnel, PIN attempts, profile deletion or downloads are enabled by this preview.
Place a carrier call using this exact SIM and route? This may incur charges. Network loss never automatically redials.
Send this message once? This may incur charges. An uncertain result must be checked in history before sending again.

Use Android 9+ and an OTG USB CCID reader supporting APDU-level exchange. An active SIM profile must already exist; locked cards are not unlocked automatically. OMAPI depends on the device and SIM access rules. A reader is not a radio: its calls/SMS use the server VoWiFi provider. Phone-installed SIM calls use the system dialer.
Stay available uses a visible foreground notification and network-change callbacks. No idle wake lock, restart watchdog, exact alarms or paid-operation retry. Android Doze/OEM restrictions can still delay incoming calls; test screen-off delivery on your phone. Reader mode needs the existing Core 10-second health interval. Pause stops sharing and notifications. No host cellular forwarding is implemented.
